reason: The independent Codex review of M8-A (dc13cc93..21821568) found that AtomicPromotionService appended the head version before taking the master_authorities row lock, the reverse of the V2-02b row-lock holders and the M8 slot authority. On PostgreSQL, such a holder and an unserialized promotion of the same slot deadlock. The fix belongs to M7, which owns the promotion: V2-02c (34bd4346). M8-A is re-based onto it.

m7_prerequisite_changes.executor_base: the commit that adds this sixth amendment
m7_prerequisite_changes.intermediate_commits: As amendment 5, plus V2-02c (34bd4346), which changes only r2/host_hardening/promotion.py, the MasterAuthorityRepository docstring, their tests and its evidence.

packets_added.head: 34bd4346
packets_added.acceptance_rule: M8-A is not accepted unless its round-2 independent review, whose range starts at dc13cc93, also accepts V2-02c.

M8-A.rebase: The M8-A commits on dc13cc93 are re-applied onto this executor base. The baseline is re-frozen with base_head = this commit; the AtomicPromotionService.promote seam hash changes.
M8-A.lock_protocol: Unchanged from amendment 5. In addition, every same-slot writer takes the master_authorities row before any master_head_versions row.
